concept: Weighing convenience against environmental impact in a realistic, non-extreme way
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student faces a realistic tradeoff between a convenient option and a more environmentally sound but less convenient one
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides case by case, rather than adopting an all-or-nothing stance
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what a reasonable, sustainable personal standard looks like

assessment.success_marker: student articulates a realistic, sustainable personal standard rather than an all-or-nothing ideal
